job.title: Interaction Designer
job.description: Luminary Games is a Chennai-based casual mobile gaming studio. We are hiring an Interaction Designer to craft delightful, game-feel-driven UI for our upcoming casual and hypercasual titles. You will design menus, HUDs, reward animations, and onboarding flows, then collaborate with Unity developers to implement them. Proficiency in Figma is required; experience with After Effects or Spine 2D for animation is a strong plus. A portfolio showing playful, motion-rich interfaces will stand out.

pool.text: Figma: designed complete UI kit for a hypercasual game — menus, HUD, reward screens, settings — with interactive prototype
After Effects: created sprite animations and UI transition animations exported as JSON via Lottie for mobile integration
BlastOff Idle: designed all UI/UX for a hypercasual idle clicker game — wireframes, hi-fi comps, and Spine 2D character animations; published on Google Play with 2 000 installs
Unity UI Toolkit: implemented designed screens in Unity 2022 using UI Toolkit and USS stylesheets
Spine 2D: rigged and animated 4 characters for a 2D platformer game prototype; exported skeletons for Unity runtime
Game UI Design Intern at PebbleArc Studios (Remote, 5 months): owned UI for 2 mini-games, iterated on reward loop screens based on playtester feedback
B.Des Interaction Design, NID Ahmedabad, 2021–2025, CGPA 8.1/10
Prototyping micro-interactions: built 10 Figma smart-animate prototypes demonstrating button press, card flip, and confetti reward states
AWS Lambda: wrote serverless functions for a web scraper side project
